mapper.select: SELECT id, work_id, title, url, description, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM work_figmas WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_figmas (work_id, title, url, description, order_num, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{description}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE work_figmas SET title = #{title}, url = #{url}, description = #{description}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
